hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" | grep -q "gh pr create" && jq -n --arg m "Reminder: nothing deploys automatically (no CI). After this PR merges, run: pnpm build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting" "{systemMessage: \$m, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: \"PostToolUse\", additionalContext: \"A pull request was just opened. In your reply, remind the user that Firebase Hosting does not deploy automatically and that after the PR merges they should run: pnpm build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting  (build first: VITE_FIREBASE_* is inlined at build time). Do not run the deploy yourself.\"}}" || true
